what: Real practice-hairdressing doll head (vinyl face, nylon hair) burned by fireworks: black carbon crust over cheeks, nose and mouth, bare pale skin where the eyes were shielded by safety glasses, scorched clumped hair, soot rising up the neck; the pink skin tone survives under the char [1400x1400]
license_or_rights: (c) 2008 Theodore W. Gray, all rights reserved (watermark in image); reference use only

what: White painted Virgin Mary garden statue set alight via plastic flowers in its hands: face, veil and upper chest blackened with soot/char, black fading downward into streaky drips over the clean white robe with a sharp tide line at the chest; closest match to a white face-like object burned from one side [2880x1620]
license_or_rights: Photo: Lucas Phillips / The Boston Globe, rights reserved; reference use only

what: Crop of the previous photo (same source file) on the statue: black soot over the hooded head and face with the features still readable, ragged boundary down the chest, white robe below with grey streaks [420x680]
license_or_rights: Photo: Lucas Phillips / The Boston Globe, rights reserved; reference use only

what: Sandstone Buddha head found 450 m from the Hiroshima hypocentre: face surface spalled and blackened over nose, cheek and chin, the rest oxidised rusty brown, serene features still readable through the damage [1536x2048]
1945 US Marine photo of a charred Buddha-type figure in the Nagasaki ruins: face and headdress blackened, the white cloth-wrapped body below untouched, so a white body under a black head [575x823]
license_or_rights: Public domain (Cpl. Lynn P. Walker Jr., US Marine Corps, 1945; per Commons)

what: Museum case of figurines and statues recovered from the Hiroshima ruins: ceramic child figure with half its face sooted black, seated figure with melted drooping face, standing statue with pitted crust, slumped glass bottles; many real heat textures on face-shaped objects [3264x2448]

Crop of the case photo: small ceramic child figure with one side of the head and face blackened with soot/char, the other half clean terracotta, soft ragged boundary between them (low resolution crop) [442x374]

Burnt gas mask (rubber face piece, filter hose, metal strap) left on a car hubcap at the Mount Carmel fire memorial: rubber slumped and fused into a grey-black lump, folds sagging, strap blackened and warped; a real melted face mask, grey rather than white [1920x1440]
license_or_rights: CC BY 3.0, Avi1111 dr. avishai teicher (Commons)

what: Carved wooden crucifix figure (legs only) from a church fire: the upper body burned away leaving a ragged broken edge with a thick black char crust on the cross behind; below it the paint-and-gesso skin has lifted into flakes with dry grey-yellow wood showing through, scorch marks on the feet [1920x2560]

Two ends of a carved church pew: one clean brown oak with saints in relief, the other burned to black char with the carved figures (hooded saint and bishop) melted down into lumpy shapes and ragged tops; shows how carved faces and edges burn first [1920x2560]

Close-up of a burned log: coarse blocky alligator char (matte black rectangular cells with deep cracks) wrapping around a patch of clean weathered grey wood; sharp boundary between char and unburned grain [1920x1280]
Extreme close-up of charred wood: glossy black polygonal cells (crocodile-skin pattern) each subdivided by finer secondary cracks, cell edges slightly curled [1024x1001]

Stack of thin boards from a burned church steeple: char creeps in from the ends and edges of each board with fine checking, ragged crumbling edges and burned-through ends, centre of the faces only browned and scorched, nail holes survive [1920x1280]

Two carbonised wooden shutters from Herculaneum (AD 79): wood turned to matte black charcoal, layered splintery surface with long vertical cracks and ragged crumbled edges, grain still readable [1920x2251]

Max Slevogt portrait of Max Erler after a fire: whole canvas under a matte grey-black soot/char skin, face and spectacles just emerging, a few patches of original red-brown paint where the skin has flaked off on the forehead and collar, vertical heat-run streaks in the background [1920x2200]

Gilded painted wooden icon of the Virgin recovered from the ruins of the Dormition Church, Kyiv (1941): top edge burned to black char with a ragged lip, gold and paint lifting near the edge, face and robes below still intact (only 400 px wide) [400x495]

Text sheet in a charred wooden frame that survived the 1944 Munich firestorm: white paper scorched from the edges inward, brown scorch frill along the bottom, black soot patches at corners and edges, cracked glass, frame wood black and flaking [1920x2622]

White enamelled clothes dryer after a fire: white paint grades through grey haze and brown tide lines to black soot with rust breaking through along the side, and a V-shaped burn plume rising up the door [612x612]

White blue-and-white porcelain bowl from Hiroshima 1945: inside glaze still glossy white but the rim has slumped into a wavy heart shape, outside glaze melted and fused with sand, stones and brick into a rough grey-green crust [1536x1249]
license_or_rights: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, Science Museum Group Collection (object 1984-663)

what: Fused mass of glazed roof tiles from Hiroshima: glaze boiled into dark brown glassy blobs, bubbles and foamy ridges, tile bodies slumped together; shows glaze blistering into froth [1920x1285]
Extreme close-up of plastic melted in a vehicle fire: blue-grey pitted crust with small blowholes, wrinkled folds and bubbled skin, matte, with lighter powdery patches [1920x1440]

Translucent plastic panelling after the Black Saturday bushfire: sheet sagged in long vertical drapes, thinned into stringy webs around a burnt-through oval hole, thick wrinkled puddles along the lower edge, smoky brown-grey tint [1765x2657]

Grey molded-plastic picnic table partly melted by a fire underneath: one edge of the tabletop has sagged and torn into a ragged drooping lip with a blackened bubbling rim, frame beneath soot-black, ash patch on the ground; the rest stays clean pale grey [1920x1440]
